id: simple-paper-qa
description: Read one paper to answer open-ended questions when evidence is missing. Clarification, translation, or rewriting of sufficient supplied text needs no paper-reading workflow. Not for Zotero library operations.
version: 10
contexts: single-paper
activation: auto
---

## Explain a paper

Use the supplied paper text and prior evidence first.
For a broad explanation, cover the question, approach, main findings, and limitations across the available paper; distinguish the authors' claims from your interpretation.
For clarification or translation of sufficient supplied text, answer directly.

Choose additional `paper_read` calls only for missing evidence or a requested closer inspection.
An overview is bounded evidence, not proof that the whole paper was read.
Use `paperEvidenceProgress` to avoid repeating unchanged reads, while deciding for yourself whether the answer needs more evidence.
When the PDF is absent or unreadable, state whether the answer rests on metadata, the abstract, or another identified source.
